name: Abigail
description: Abigail lives at the general store with her parents. She sometimes fights with her mom, who worries about Abigail's 'alternative lifestyle'. Her mom has the following to say: 'I wish Abby would dress more appropriately and stop dyeing her hair blue. She has such a wonderful natural hair color, just like her grandmother did. Oh, and I wish she'd find some wholesome interests instead of this... 'goth' nonsense. Sigh... Well, I suppose she's free to be herself.'

name: Alex
description: Alex is a villager who lives in the house southeast of Pierre's General Store. Alex loves sports and hanging out at the beach. He is quite arrogant and brags to everyone that he is going to be a professional athlete.

name: Caroline
description: Caroline is a villager who lives in Pelican Town. She's married to Pierre and together they live with their daughter Abigail on the second floor of Pierre's General Store.

name: Clint
description: Clint is the local blacksmith. He can upgrade your tools and break open geodes. He's quite shy, especially around Emily.

name: Demetrius
description: Demetrius is a scientist who studies the local wildlife, particularly cave creatures. He's married to Robin and is Maru's father and Sebastian's stepfather.

name: Elliott
description: Elliott lives alone in a cabin on the beach. He is a writer who dreams of one day writing a magnificent novel. He is a sentimental 'romantic' with a tendency to go off onto flowery, poetic tangents.

name: Emily
description: Emily is a villager who lives in Pelican Town. She is one of the twelve characters available to marry. She works most evenings at The Stardrop Saloon starting at about 4:00 PM.

name: Evelyn
description: Evelyn is a villager who lives in Pelican Town, and is in charge of the town's flowers. She's Alex's grandmother and George's wife.

name: George
description: George is a villager who lives in Pelican Town. He's Alex's grandfather and Evelyn's husband. He's confined to a wheelchair and seems to have a permanently bad mood.

name: Gus
description: Gus is a villager who lives and works at The Stardrop Saloon in Pelican Town. He cooks and serves food to the other villagers.

name: Haley
description: Haley is a villager who lives in Pelican Town. She's one of the twelve characters available to marry. She can often be found taking pictures with her camera.

name: Harvey
description: Harvey is the town doctor. He's a little old for a bachelor, but he has a kind heart and a respected position in the community. He lives alone in an apartment above the medical clinic.

name: Jas
description: Jas is a villager who lives in Marnie's Ranch in the Cindersap Forest. She's Shane's goddaughter and Marnie's niece.

name: Jodi
description: Jodi is a villager who lives in Pelican Town. She's married to Kent (when he returns from service) and has two sons, Sam and Vincent.

name: Kent
description: Kent is a villager who lives in Pelican Town. He's Jodi's husband and Sam and Vincent's father. He returns from military service in the second year.

name: Leah
description: Leah is a villager who lives in a small cottage outside Pelican Town. She's one of the twelve characters available to marry. She enjoys spending time in nature and creating art.

name: Lewis
description: Lewis is the mayor of Pelican Town. He's been mayor for over 20 years and takes his job very seriously. He has a secret relationship with Marnie.

name: Linus
description: Linus is a homeless man who lives in a tent north of Pelican Town in the mountains. He forage for food and lives off the land.

name: Marnie
description: Marnie is a villager who lives in Marnie's Ranch in the Cindersap Forest. She sells animals and animal supplies. She has a secret relationship with Mayor Lewis.

name: Maru
description: Maru is a villager who lives in the mountains north of Pelican Town. She's one of the twelve characters available to marry. She's Robin's daughter and Demetrius's stepdaughter.

name: Pam
description: Pam is a villager who lives in a trailer just south of Pelican Town. She drives the bus when it's repaired and is Penny's mother.

name: Penny
description: Penny is a villager who lives in Pelican Town. She's one of the twelve characters available to marry. She tutors Jas and Vincent at the library and museum.

name: Pierre
description: Pierre is a villager who lives in Pelican Town. He owns and operates Pierre's General Store. He's married to Caroline and is Abigail's father.

name: Robin
description: Robin is a villager who lives in the mountains north of Pelican Town. She owns the local carpenter shop and builds upgrades for your farmhouse and other farm buildings.

name: Sam
description: Sam is a villager who lives in Pelican Town. He's one of the twelve characters available to marry. He plays guitar and drums, and wants to start a band with Sebastian and Abigail.

name: Sebastian
description: Sebastian is a villager who lives in the basement of his mother Robin's carpenter shop, north of town. He's one of the twelve characters available to marry.

name: Shane
description: Shane is a villager in Pelican Town who is often rude and unhappy, and suffers from depression and alcohol dependence. However, his attitude starts to change towards any player who chooses to befriend him.

name: Vincent
description: Vincent is a villager who lives in Pelican Town. He's Sam's younger brother and one of the few children in town. He's often seen playing with Jas.

name: Willy
description: Willy is a villager who lives in a small house on the beach south of Pelican Town. He owns the fish shop and teaches the player how to fish.

name: Wizard
description: The Wizard, also known as Magnus Rasmodius, is a villager who lives in the Wizard's Tower to the far south of Pelican Town. He is involved in many of the magical elements of the game.
